info.title: Greenhouse Platform — Optimizer Outcome-Report API (activity-feed audit path)
info.description: The platform Go API's ingest for optimizer cycle-outcome reports — the audit twin of the single-authority setpoint write (contract `optimizer-platform-setpoints-rest`). An applied plan already reaches the activity feed as its setpoint write, and an extended cycle writes nothing, so the outcomes the optimizer cannot otherwise surface — an escalation held for review, or a run that produced no usable plan — are reported here so the platform can emit the matching `optimizer_plan_escalated` / `optimizer_run_failed` activity event (`platform-dashboard-rest` EventEntry, spec 05 §Events). One endpoint: `POST /api/greenhouses/{greenhouse_id}/optimizer-outcomes`. Only escalations carry a feed event; a non-escalated report is accepted as a no-op. Reporting is best-effort telemetry — the optimizer never lets a failure here break a cycle. Identity, units, and field naming follow RFC-007 (snake_case, the same `greenhouse_id` slug). Authentication is the config-gated service boundary (RFC-011), the same seam as the setpoint write: `SERVICE_AUTH_MODE=trusted_network` (default) accepts the untokened internal call; `oidc` requires a Keycloak client-credentials token carrying the `setpoints:write` role (or an operator token). The `{}` scheme is listed first, so the token is optional at the contract level — enforcement is gated on config.

servers.description: The platform's nginx entry point, which reverse-proxies `/api` to the Go API. The optimizer reaches this ingest over the internal Docker network.

bearerAuth.description: Config-gated service token (RFC-011) — the same `setpoints:write` service seam as the setpoint write. Required only under `SERVICE_AUTH_MODE=oidc`; the default `trusted_network` accepts the untokened internal call.

OptimizerOutcomeReport.description: One cycle's outcome, reported for the activity feed. The platform maps an escalation whose `reason_code` is a run-failure code (`cycle_timeout` / `llm_unavailable` / `plan_unparseable` / `internal_error`) to an `optimizer_run_failed` event, and any other escalation reason to `optimizer_plan_escalated`; both warnings, sourced to the optimizer, with the reason + run id + `message` composed into the event message for troubleshooting.

optimizer_run_id.description: The cycle's trace id (optimizer_run_id), correlating the event with the optimizer console and the escalation queue.

status.description: The cycle outcome. Held and failed outcomes produce activity events; applied surfaces through its setpoint write and unchanged is a no-op.

reason_code.description: The escalation reason code (the optimizer's canonical ReasonCode set), or null. Selects `optimizer_run_failed` vs `optimizer_plan_escalated`.

message.description: The cycle's own outcome detail (e.g. "cycle exceeded cycle_timeout_seconds (240s)"), folded into the event message. May be null.

parameters.name: greenhouse_id
parameters.description: The greenhouse the cycle ran for (the RFC-007 slug).

post.summary: Report a cycle outcome to the activity feed

202.description: The report was accepted (an escalation emitted its event; a non-escalated report was a no-op).
